items.title: Introduction
items.author: PIYUSH
items.description: Morph is a UI framework that compiles .mx files (JSX-like syntax with TypeScript and CSS) directly into native OpenGL binaries — no browser, no Electron, no WebView.

items.title: Questions & Answers
items.author: PIYUSH
items.description: Questions and answers about Morph — Electron, C++, React, npm, hot reload, and production readiness, answered in detail.

items.title: Is Morph Just Electron with Extra Steps?
items.author: PIYUSH
items.description: Is Morph just Electron with extra steps? No — it's the opposite: no browser, no Chromium; your code compiles to native machine code.

items.title: Do I Need to Know C++ to Use Morph?
items.author: PIYUSH
items.description: Do you need to know C++ to use Morph? No — you write .mx files; C++ is an implementation detail, optional if you want to go deeper.

items.title: Is Morph React? Can I Use React?
items.author: PIYUSH
items.description: Is Morph React? It's React-inspired — JSX, state, effects — but there's no virtual DOM; state changes re-render native nodes directly.

items.title: Is Morph for Games or Apps?
items.author: PIYUSH
items.description: Is Morph for games or apps? Apps — a UI framework for native desktop applications, with an embedded OpenGL canvas for 2D/3D content.

items.title: Can I Build Websites with Morph?
items.author: PIYUSH
items.description: Can you build websites with Morph? No — Morph builds native desktop binaries; the web already has the best web tooling in existence.

items.title: What Happens to My JavaScript at Runtime?
items.author: PIYUSH
items.description: What happens to your JavaScript at runtime? It's compiled to C++ — no interpreter, no JIT, no VM; your logic runs as native machine code.

items.title: Can I Use npm Packages in Morph?
items.author: PIYUSH
items.description: Can you use npm packages in Morph? Not yet — but a Morph registry for UI and native C++ modules is planned, with a security-first approach.

items.title: How Does Hot Reload Work with a Compiler?
items.author: PIYUSH
items.description: How does hot reload work if everything is compiled? Dev mode keeps the app running and hot-swaps the compiled logic module without restarting.

items.title: Is Morph Production-Ready?
items.author: PIYUSH
items.description: Is Morph production-ready? Not yet — the roadmap is honest about what's missing: platform support, accessibility, signing, and more.
